office_does: State Representatives write and vote on state laws and the state budgets; this seat is one of two House seats for Tacoma-area District 27.
race_blurb: House Speaker Laurie Jinkins, a Democrat elected in 2010, faces Republican Carole Sue Braaten, a Fife precinct committee officer who ran for State Senate in 2024. They split on taxes, public safety, reproductive and gender policy, and parental rights.

candidates.summary: Speaker of the House since 2020 and a public health lawyer, running on the Legislature's record in housing, health care, school funding and tax changes.
highlights: Voted for ESSB 6346 (2026 tax on income over $1 million) and the 2025 capital gains, B&O, services sales tax and gas tax bills [S6][S12][S14][S16][S20]
Says she has worked on "fixing our regressive tax system" [S1]
Voted for the 2025 rent-increase limit (EHB 1217) and campaigns on tenant protections [S3][S18]
Pledges to keep reproductive rights "legal and safe"; voted for ESHB 1296 and ESSB 5599 [S1][S8][S10]

taxes.basis: Voted for ESSB 6346 and every 2025 revenue bill reviewed, and calls the tax system regressive.

spending.basis: Runs on 'historic' K-12 and housing investment, expanded childcare and free college for low-income families.

housing.basis: Voted for the 2025 rent-increase limit and calls for tenant protections, supportive housing and low-income construction.

safety.basis: Cites public-safety improvements and gun-violence reduction alongside a pledge to 'transform our policing systems, increase accountability' (undated site).

climate.basis: Undated campaign site calls climate change an existential threat and says she kept the House moving on climate policy.

experience.basis: In the House since her 2010 election and Speaker since 2020.

social.basis: Pledges to keep reproductive rights legal, backs bodily-autonomy rights for women and LGBTQ people, and voted for ESSB 5599.

parental-rights.basis: Voted for ESHB 1296's changes to the I-2081 parental-rights list and for ESSB 5599's shelter non-notification provision; no statements on the topic.

candidates.summary: Fife precinct committee officer with a background in code enforcement, forestry and caregiving, running on no income tax, tough-on-crime policing and parents' rights.
highlights: Lists "Balance the budget yearly, No Income tax" among her priorities [S1]
Says "Support our Law enforcement and tough on crime" [S1]
Opposes "biological boy/men" in girls' and women's restrooms, sports and prisons [S1]
Ran for the 27th District Senate seat in 2024 and received about 28 percent in the general [S3]

spending.basis: Calls for balancing the budget yearly, with no further detail.

safety.basis: Supports law enforcement and being 'tough on crime.'

experience.basis: Only office is precinct committee officer; lost a 2024 State Senate race.

social.basis: Opposes 'biological boy/men' in girls' and women's restrooms, sports and prisons.
